title: Cursor disappears when hovering over the vehicle build sidebar icon
description: The mouse cursor disappears when hovering over the vehicle build sidebar icon. Reproduce and fix the hover behavior so the appropriate cursor remains visible over the icon and when moving onto or off it.

title: Chrono Miners should teleport to the refinery when full using the original animation
description: When a Chrono Miner reaches full ore capacity, it should teleport back to its ore refinery to unload. Use the specific original game teleport animation for this behavior. Preserve the normal unloading and harvesting cycle after returning to the refinery.

title: Make George GI-sized and an autonomous civilian inspector without upgrades

Keep him buildable, but once built he must be non-controllable by the player, like other civilians. title: Change the IFV sprite to match its infantry passenger

title: Restrict IFV passengers to infantry
description: Only infantry should be able to enter IFVs. Enforce infantry-only passenger eligibility for IFVs; non-infantry units must not be able to board them.

title: Play a sound when selecting a different build tab

title: Restore missing background music during gameplay
description: The user cannot hear background music during gameplay. Investigate why it is missing and restore in-game background music, respecting existing audio settings and browser playback requirements.

title: Produced vehicles should drive out through the War Factory exit
description: Vehicles currently appear beside the War Factory when production finishes. Make newly produced vehicles visibly emerge through the factory entrance/exit and drive out, rather than suddenly appearing next to the building.

title: Restyle mobile toolbar: five visual variants in separate PRs for human review
description:
The mobile-only toolbar works well, but its styling looks a bit boring. Restyle it slightly to better fit the aesthetic of the game while preserving its existing functionality and mobile-only behavior.

Prepare five distinct visual variants for the human user to compare. Create five separate pull requests, one per variant, targeting main. Each PR should clearly describe its design and include a screenshot showing the variant in the mobile game UI, visible directly in the PR description.

The human user must review the variants and choose one before any variant is merged. Keep the five variants separate so each PR can be reviewed independently.

After creating the five PRs and adding their screenshots, switch the working checkout back to main for the rest of the work. Record all five PR links in this ticket and leave it awaiting human review/selection.

Acceptance criteria:
- Five distinct, modest styling variants fit the existing game aesthetic.
- Existing toolbar controls, behavior, and mobile-only visibility remain functional.
- Five separate PRs target main, with one variant per PR.
- Every PR description includes a screenshot of its variant in the mobile game UI.
- The human user can review and choose one; no variant is merged before that review and selection.
- All five PR links are recorded in this ticket, and the working checkout is returned to main after preparing the variants.
